{{Top|leg}}

'''Cub-peddlers''' were traffickers that peddled the live infants of many [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]]. They would primarily sell to members of carnivorous [[Species/Legends|species]] who viewed the infants as a delicacy. Hundreds of cub-peddlers operated on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] where there was a lack of law enforcement to shut down their operations and an abundance of hungry buyers. While [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and a newborn [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] were on Nar Shaddaa seeking passage to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], a [[Rakaan]] mistook the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] for a cub-peddler. In response to his attempts to purchase Luke from him, Kenobi [[Mind trick/Legends|mind tricked]] the Rakaan into reporting every cub-peddler he finds to sympathetic [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].
